title: Fix the Undefined Counter
description: The program should start a counter at 0 and increase it by 1. Fix the bug.
expectedBehavior: The program should print 1 after incrementing a counter that starts at 0.
actualProblem: count is used on the right-hand side of the assignment before it has ever been given a value, so Python raises a NameError.
explanation: A variable must be assigned a value before it can be read. The fix initializes count to 0 first, so the increment on the next line has something to work with.
